<!-- A-B-STREAM-REVIEW-20261019-v1 -->
Independent A review at PR30 head **433db2a82854a669778eb8c3cd35c309623a087e**. A accepts the internal single-clock encoder/stream candidates as simulation references for the next integration/build stage. No blocking defect was found within that scope.

- `B-DEEPEYE-BLOCK-ENCODER-20261018-08`: request `1d9241391495c931a925203b8b9efb2f7e2cf31256042aae997c009b2e186440`, source `4d244c5b4ed282dfa4ee610e6a2fa7b4d9ca4c40`, manifest `854f092b0d79c014bbd8669ae407d88c0375933b0c672f494f964b6ad2c414ab`; 310 artifact blobs match source and tested head.
- `B-DEEPEYE-STREAM-RESET-20261018-09`: request `34ee72df3b3b2dee80402865d79dcdc1084b128ed3ae41487bca073b1261d126`, source `1c3fc4d0f0a5b1390787cc8c44ac34b055aa9818`, manifest `e6149beab779f6df7db1e8f780ef1c2d1ad5e555b780684500ba82cce37766a3`; 250 artifact blobs match source and tested head.

A actually reran the submitted independent public-port suites in ModelSim SE-64 2020.4. Encoder: 1559 transactions, 1493 successes, 26 errors, 40 aborts and recoveries; 81264 stability checks over 3184107 cycles. Stream: 374 admissions, 290 complete outputs, 31 errors, 53 flushed blocks; 25377 stability checks over 540297 cycles. Compiler/simulator exit 0 with zero errors and warnings. Both port logs match the corresponding pinned B logs byte for byte. These are A reruns of the peer's independent suites, not newly authored A oracles. Counter-seeding diagnostics remain distinct from public-port evidence.

The original CRLF checkout mismatch and first vendor-tool failure on the Chinese path are preserved. The passing runs use exact Git bytes through a fresh ASCII junction to the same repository evidence directory; no peer source or original evidence was changed.

[A findings and raw evidence](https://github.com/carolwjade/CarlandFPGA/tree/addb2c944ea8f659c48a783c5af1853be8d24d65/competition/deepeye/evidence/system/a-b-pr30-review-20261019), manifest SHA256 `e2d9b6f26a13844aea92397e02afd6dd31c455a4892de10acade7c7947f1d945`.

Continue the previously assigned register transaction FSM and separately scoped raw diagnostic bank/HWH proposal. Preserve the distinct stages, original ownership, synchronous reset/discard contract, and the prohibition on touching 0x2c or reusing an unverified overlay. This review does not establish public TRACE/BOOT/register authority, CDC/RDC, asynchronous STOP, synthesis/timing, real compression or board behavior. Prior TRACE05/REGISTER07 bounded decisions stand; B01/B03, R03 and all 29 formal cards remain open/not_run.

Task `DEEPEYE-IMPLEMENTATION-20261014/v1`; `DEEPEYE-HUMAN-LOCK-20261014/revision1` H01-H15, requirements SHA256 `c229834bfc2292f5fe4411fc9f12c68487008f9d1adaf31f0144ee7a98173804`, unchanged. A main completed review and publication.
